items.question: What are the defining form and status of the sixth chakra?
premises: The sixth chakra is identified in sequence.
It is characterized as royal in status.
It is described as having eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth chakra is a royal center distinguished by eight petals and a pericarp.
uncertainties: The gender agreement of rājānam with cakraṃ is unusual and may reflect an epithetic usage.
items.plain_english: But the sixth chakra is royal, eight-petaled, and has a pericarp.
